cobblemon_stones.configured: minecraft:ore size 3, discard 0.0, targets stone_ore_replaceables -> <x>_stone_ore, deepslate_ore_replaceables -> deepslate_<x>_stone_ore; sun_stone also tag minecraft:terracotta -> terracotta_sun_stone_ore

ore_configs.cobblemon_fire_stone_nether: minecraft:ore size 5 block_match netherrack; count 1 uniform above_bottom 10..below_top 10; #cobblemon:has_ore/ore_fire_stone_nether (#minecraft:is_nether)

lumymon.dragon_ore: scattered_ore size 1 block_match sculk; count 30 uniform -60..0; deep_dark
lumymon.electron_ore: scattered_ore size 1 block_match sandstone; count 1 uniform 30..90; desert

legendarymonuments.deepslate_galar_particle_ore_placed: minecraft:ore size 5 deepslate_ore_replaceables; count 10, trapezoid -24..56; foundInOverworld()

ore_configs.mega_showdown_keystone: no worldgen feature; mega_showdown:keystone_ore appears once in data/mega_showdown/structure/megaroid.nbt

density_model.formula: D(y) per 1,000 host blocks = 1000 * count / rarity * B * p(y) / 256

calibration.source_relation: promille threshold = frequency * 0.9^(8 - layerValue) (UndergroundPocketsLayerExporter.java:29); noise cell = 4.099 * scale / 100 blocks (:31); pockets stop topLayerDepth below the surface (:73); applyLayer default value 8 for nibble layers (MappingOp.java:74)
calibration.sweep: 42 worlds, frequency {1,2,5,10,20,50} x scale {5,10,20,35,50,100,200}, value 8, one SIMPLE layer -64..319, measured rows -63..94 (10,354,688 cells)
calibration.relation: permille ~= 0.75 (0.47-0.88) * frequency * 0.9^(8 - value) * q, q = ore/(ore+host) for a NOISE MixedMaterial; blob size set by scale: <=35 single blocks, 50 ~1.1-1.4, 100 ~2.5-6, 200 16+
calibration.floor_without_dilution: frequency 1 value 1 = 0.263 permille, still 2.7x the Cobblemon normal stone target and 9x the deepslate target
